definitions.gloss: academia; the academic world; scholarly circles
definitions.explanation: The community of scholars and researchers as a whole, or within one field.

examples.japanese: {学界|がっかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is attracting attention in academic circles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説|せつ}→説：00360_setsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{学界|がっかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れられなかった→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
examples.english: His theory was not accepted by the academic world.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{考古学|こうこがく}→考古学：20088_koukogaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学界|がっかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えた→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: The discovery came as a great shock to the world of archaeology.

notes:
A written word, common in news and nonfiction. It is pronounced exactly like ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧ and the two are easily confused.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧: an academic society or a conference (⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{言語学会|げんごがっかい}, ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧); a specific organization or meeting
- {学界|がっかい}: the academic world as a whole, as in {学界|がっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{常識|じょうしき}→常識：03287_joushiki⟧ "accepted wisdom among scholars"
- アカデミア: academia (more recent loanword)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学界|がっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定説|ていせつ}→定説：12462_teisetsu⟧: the established view among scholars
- {学界|がっかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{衝撃|しょうげき}→衝撃：08678_shougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to shock the academic world
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧・⟦{財界|ざいかい}→財界：22340_zaikai⟧・{学界|がっかい}: politics, business and academia
